We chase things that impress others but leave us cold. Or we save endlessly, afraid to spend on what would actually make life better. We confuse admiration with envy, comfort with excess, and utility with status. The Art of Spending Money doesn't provide budgets, hacks, or one-size-fits-all solutions. It gives you understanding of how your relationship with money shapes your decisions—and how to reshape it so money…

items.title: Tell Me You Love Me
items.author: Ella Quinn
items.desc: A career diplomat pursues his perfect match in this charming Regency romance set in the delightful world of bestselling author Ella Quinn’s much-loved Worthingtons and their extended family—where true love is the ultimate temptation. For fans of sexy, sparkling historical romance by authors like Julia Quinn, Sabrina Jeffries, Amalie Howard, Martha Waters, and Evie Dunmore. After years stationed in Spain as a diplomate with Britain’s Foreign Service, the time has come for Mr. Walter Carpenter, brother-in-law to the Earl of Worthington, to marry. But Walter’s plans to wed his true love—and…

items.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship! (Manga) Vol. 11
items.author: Ryuto & Shunichi Matsui
items.desc: Hiro and crew find themselves in a fierce battle against crystal lifeforms that swarmed an outpost! They desperately formulate a plan for a suicide attack with Lieutenant Serena, but somehow everyone manages to return with their skins intact! Hiro is then awarded medals and even treated like nobles! Oh boy, mission accomplished...but then, Serena has another, even more dangerous, job for our former salaryman turned space merc?!

items.title: A Married Little Christmas
items.author: Abby Jimenez
items.desc: Bring on the holiday cheer in this New York Times bestselling collection of three feel-good novellas—with bonus recipes and full-page illustrations! Tis the season to fall in love! Anna thought only the food would be a disaster at her Christmas dinner—until her high school ex shows up and they quickly have to hatch a fake-dating scheme to save face with their families. For Matty, the idea of sitting in a diner all day dressed as a zombie Santa after losing a bet has zero appeal. But his cute and funny server might just make him change his mind. And finally, will Lauren be able to convince her…

items.title: Some Can Whistle
items.author: Larry McMurtry
items.desc: A poignant, richly comic follow-up to All My Friends Are Going to Be Strangers , Larry McMurtry revisits now-millionaire Danny Deck as the daughter he’s never met upends his comfortable world. “Mr. Deck, are you my stinkin’ Daddy?” In a furious phone call from T.R.—the daughter he’s never met—Danny Deck gets the biggest jolt of his life. A TV writer who has retired to his Texas mansion, Danny spends his days talking to the answering machines of his ex-lovers from New York to Paris and dreaming of the characters in the sitcom he’s created. But suddenly, a hurricane called T.R. is storming into…
